description: This file documents the Thunder framework's subsystems mechanism, including subsystem definitions, how plugins can set and check subsystem states, notifications, metadata configuration, and example code snippets. It provides a comprehensive overview of how subsystems are abstracted and managed within the framework.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Marks a subsystem as active or inactive, using subsystem identifiers like INTERNET or NOT_INTERNET.

methods.name: IsActive
methods.description: Checks whether a specific subsystem is currently active.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the interface containing metadata about a subsystem, such as IP address or network type.

methods.name: Updated
methods.description: Callback invoked when the state of a subsystem has changed, used in notification subscriptions.
